core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hajib is an Arabic-origin name meaning “A doorkeeper, chamberlain, guardian; also the eyebrow”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hajib corresponds to the Arabic form حاجب (Arabic root ح ج ب (ḥ-j-b); حاجب (ḥājib)). Its core sense is protector, guardian, preserver. Hajib is Arabic حاجب (ḥājib) 'a doorkeeper, chamberlain, guardian; also the eyebrow' (from ح ج ب 'to screen, veil'). The source gloss 'guardian or protector' is a reasonable rendering of the chamberlain/guardian sense.
